Subject: UnifiedRetail Summit — coordinating demos, security review, and evening leadership dinner

Jordan —

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier. As we discussed, Redwood will be on-site for the UnifiedRetail Summit track (June 14–16). I wanted to get a single-thread plan so we can lock in times across AE/SE, procurement, and security. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm who from your side will attend the 60m technical demo (SE deep-dive) vs. the 30m product overview (exec-focused).
- Procurement: Aditi, can you confirm any PO/contract timings we should be aware of?
- Security: Miguel, we'd like a 20–30m pre-demo security Q&A (artifact review) ideally before the demo.

Proposed windows (all local times):
- June 15, 10:00–11:00 — technical demo (Diego to run deep-dive + live integration test)
- June 15, 15:00–15:30 — exec product overview (Grace to lead)
- June 15, 19:00 — leadership dinner (Redwood execs + UnifiedRetail execs)

Attachments: redwood-summit-demo-agenda.pdf (draft) — includes tech checklist and demo data set notes.

If the leadership dinner timing doesn’t work, we’re flexible to move between 19:00–20:30. Please flag any conflicts and any additional stakeholders we should include.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Marcus —

Appreciate the clear slots. Quick notes from our side:

- Execs can do the product overview but will need the start pushed to 15:30 (they have a board prep session beforehand).
- For the technical demo, the lead infra engineer (Samir Bhandari) will attend — he prefers morning windows and would like 75 minutes total if possible (30m for architecture discussion + 45m for live test). Can we extend the technical slot to 10:00–11:15?
- Procurement (Aditi) — we usually request at least 72 hours to route any contract changes internally. Aditi, is that still accurate?
- Security (Miguel) — Miguel asked if you can share your SOC2 scope and the quick evidence matrix before the pre-demo sync. He suggested a short call Tuesday (May 25) at 10:00am ET for a 20–30m intake.

Dinner: Our exec team is available June 15 but prefers a 7:30pm start. If that works, please confirm the venue so we can block calendars.

Thanks — Jordan
VP Product, UnifiedRetail
